payload.title: Tactus books 1: docs builder book mode (_quarto.yml nav, snippet includes, metadata substitution)
payload.description: Part of PPY-81c9b9. In papyrus_content.markus_renderer.docs_site: read book.chapters and part groups from _quarto.yml into sidebar groups with previous/next links; treat .qmd as Markdown; expand {file= snippet= show-path=} fences from -- snippet:start/end markers and fail on a missing snippet; replace {{< meta KEY >}} from book-links.yml and tactus-target.yml. Unit tests with a small chapter fixture. Cloud work, Papyrus only. Plan: /mnt/project-files/anthus-sites-to-papyrus/tactus-books-inventory-and-plan.md
